== Biography ==
{{Scotland Sticker}}
Margaret was baptised on 21 January 1734 in Kilbirnie, Ayrshire, Scotland.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Margaret Glasgow 21 Jan 1734, daughter of Robert Glasgow and Margarat Allan; citing Ref No: 10 / 85, parish 596.
</ref> She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1075|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Allan-4046|Margaret Allan]].<ref>"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XY24-MS6 : 11 February 2020), Margarat Glasgow, 1734.</ref> Margaret passed away before 21 August 1743.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Margarat Glasgow 21 Aug 1743, daughter of Robert Glasgow and Margarat Allan; citing Ref No: 10 / 105, parish 596.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1075]] is assessed at 93% (proved). The held NRS citation says Margarat, daughter of Robert Glasgow and Margarat Allan,21 August 1743, matching the surgeon’s established family. A separate 1734 FamilySearch citation and child boundary conflict materially on event identity, so certainty is lower than siblings.

Robert/Allan fatherhood is strong if either cited daughter event is this account; the 1734 versus 1743 child identity is unresolved.

Next useful test: Compare the 1734 entry XY24-MS6 and original 1743 ref10/105 to determine one miscitation versus two daughters.

Source basis already held: [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland (ScotlandsPeople (https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk) : image accessed 13 May 2026), Margarat Glasgow 21 Aug 1743, daughter of Robert Glasgow and Margarat Allan; citing Ref No: 10 / 105, parish 596.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


=== Further Kilbirnie derivative indexes, 24 October 2026 ===

[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_688615340 Findmypast R_688615340] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685309484 R_685309484] are companion derivative indexes of one baptism on 21 January 1734 at Kilbirnie. Both name father Robert Glasgow and mother Margarat Allan. They agree with the already cited 1734 National Records of Scotland/FamilySearch event and support this profile as the 1734 child account; they do not independently establish an exact birth date, a death before 1743, or whether the separate 21 August 1743 same-name entry is another daughter or a conflicting reading. The birth-before-baptism boundary, estimated death and unresolved 1734/1743 identity issue remain qualified. Robert Glasgow-1075 stays the selected father at 93% under its existing scope; no parent attachment is changed. The original registers for both dates are the next test.
